description: Public and authentication surface: landing page, login, customer self-registration, and a public services-catalog browse page. Establishes the entry flow and the redirect-to-role-home behavior. Depends on FEAT-001 (api-client, services, auth-context, guards, shared UI).
steps: Create a public route group frontend/src/app/(public)/ with a simple, attractive landing page describing MotorCenter and linking to login/register and the public catalog.

Build the login page (frontend/src/app/(public)/login/page.tsx) using react-hook-form + zod: email (valid email) and password (min 1). On submit call the useLogin mutation; on success store the session via auth-context and redirect to the user's role home using the role->home map; on error show a toast and inline field/message errors from the backend error envelope.

Build the register page (frontend/src/app/(public)/register/page.tsx) with zod rules mirroring backend/src/validations/auth.validation.ts: name min 2 max 100, valid email, password min 6, phone min 8. Backend always assigns role pelanggan. On success store session and redirect to /pelanggan.

Build the public catalog page consuming the PUBLIC GET /api/services (no auth) via useServices, rendering service cards (name, description, estimatedPrice via Rupiah formatter, estimatedDurationMinutes) with loading skeletons and an empty state.
Ensure already-authenticated users visiting /login or /register are redirected to their role home.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build and pnpm run lint pass.
Logging in with each seeded account (admin, kasir, mekanik, pemilik, pelanggan) redirects to the correct role home.
Register validation blocks invalid input client-side with messages, and backend 409 duplicate-email errors surface as a readable toast/inline message.
The public catalog renders services from the API with no hardcoded data, including loading and empty states.

findings: Public surface built under route group frontend/src/app/(public)/ (route groups do NOT change the URL): landing at '/', '/login', '/register', '/catalog'. Removed the old frontend/src/app/page.tsx (landing now lives in the group). Added a shared public header in (public)/layout.tsx linking to /catalog, /login, /register. FEAT-003..005 that add role areas (/pelanggan, /staff, /mekanik, /owner) create their OWN route groups/layouts; do not nest them under (public). New reusable helpers created this step: (1) hooks/use-redirect-authenticated.ts -> useRedirectAuthenticated(): redirects an already-authenticated visitor to homeForRole(user.role) and returns {redirecting} for a loading state; reuse on any other public-only page. (2) lib/form-errors.ts -> applyApiFieldErrors(error, form.setError, knownFields): maps backend Zod errors=[{field,location,message}] onto RHF fields, stripping the leading 'body.' prefix the backend uses; reuse for all forms. Login calls useLogin() then router.replace(homeForRole(result.user.role)) in the mutate onSuccess callback (component-level, not only the hook toast). Register calls useRegister() and redirects to /pelanggan (backend always assigns role pelanggan). ROLE_HOME map (lib/roles.ts): pelanggan->/pelanggan, kasir->/staff, admin->/staff, mekanik->/mekanik, pemilik->/owner. Catalog consumes the PUBLIC GET /api/services via useServices() (data.data array) with skeleton loading, ErrorState with retry, and EmptyState; includes a local formatDuration() helper for estimatedDurationMinutes and formatRupiah() for price - no hardcoded services.
